summary: {person} has to explain who will do the summer work after the seasonal hiring round falls through.
realLife: Seattle Parks skipped seasonal maintenance hiring in 2024 amid a partial city hiring freeze and unbudgeted costs, leaving regular crews stretched during peak use.
gates: A seasonal hiring plan, actual hires and a summer service schedule.
weights: An approaching peak season gives a vacancy an immediate service cost.
inGame: needs: authorized seasonal posts, actual start dates and summer shift coverage.

turns.what: The scheduler restores the second round at busy parks.
turns.pulledBy: A hiring exception arrives before summer.
turns.writesBack: Update the roster and start dates.

turns.what: The director describes which rounds went uncovered.
turns.pulledBy: The exception arrives after peak use.
turns.writesBack: Keep the missed visits in the summer report.
